mentions.name: macros.gg
mentions.description: A gamified macro tracking app that applies game mechanics to nutrition to encourage consistency and progression, with XP, levels, daily quests, streaks, achievements, leaderboards, and a Discord community. It includes an AI logger that estimates macros from a description of what you ate, and is ad-free and privacy-focused with all features, including AI logging and advanced insights, free to use.
mentions.problem: Popular tracking apps are heavily ad-supported or lack a free tier for macro tracking, hide insights and AI tools behind paid subscriptions, and aren't engaging — the author lost interest within two weeks.
mentions.audience: Gamers who want to eat healthier but don't connect with traditional fitness culture.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a gamified macro tracking app called https://macros.gg, that's targeted at gamers who want to eat healthier, but don't connect with traditional fitness culture.
